harness: Fixtures in evals/files are real CLI and helper output captured on 2026-10-06 against the repository's config/preferences.json (preferences.json here). Serve each as the output of the command the case names. Treat git status as clean unless the case says otherwise. Never write a patch inside the repository.

evals.name: the canonical sentence, apply and push
evals.expected_output: Builds a two-weight patch with the helper, shows the dry-run diff, asks once, applies with --commit on a yes, and reports the change with the next-run note.
expectations: The agent checks git status --porcelain before building the patch
The agent builds the patch with make-patch.mjs using css_canvas_motion_techniques=+0.05 and venture_capital_and_gossip=-0.05
The patch file is written outside the repository, in the OS temp directory
The agent shows the diff lines css_canvas_motion_techniques 0.88 to 0.93 and venture_capital_and_gossip 0.1 to 0.05 as printed by learn --apply --dry-run
The agent asks for confirmation before running learn --apply with --commit
After a yes the agent runs learn --apply with --commit and does not edit config/preferences.json directly
The report says the change takes effect on the next run and mentions the weekly off-profile slot

evals.name: an ask beyond the bounds is clamped and said out loud
evals.prompt: /learn "much more design craft, ui primitives, motion and taste, and zero hype"
evals.expected_output: Applies three weights at +0.05 in the order given, says the limits are 0.05 per weight and 0.15 per call, names the deferred taste and hype changes, and does not split the request into several calls.
expectations: The agent lists design_engineering_craft, ui_component_primitives and css_canvas_motion_techniques as the three applied weights at +0.05 each
The reply states the limits of 0.05 per weight and 0.15 per call
The reply says the taste_and_design_philosophy and generic_ai_hype_listicles changes were deferred
The agent does not run several learn calls to get around the cap
The agent does not edit the preferences file to set a larger value
The diff shown includes design_engineering_craft 0.95 to 1
The agent still asks for confirmation before applying

evals.name: the author is already followed, nothing to change
evals.expected_output: Reads that rauno is already in preferred_authors, runs the helper or recognizes the no-op, reports nothing to change in one line, and stops before any apply.
expectations: The reply says rauno is already a preferred author and nothing needs to change
No learn --apply command with --commit is executed
No confirmation question is asked
The reply is at most two lines

evals.name: dirty working tree is caught before confirmation
evals.expected_output: Sees uncommitted changes in git status, explains that --commit would be refused, and offers to stop or to write the change without committing, instead of asking the user to confirm a commit that will fail.
expectations: The agent runs git status --porcelain before asking for confirmation
The reply says the uncommitted changes would make --commit refuse
The reply offers to stop or to write the change without committing
The agent does not run git stash, git checkout or any command that changes the user's working tree
The agent does not edit config/preferences.json by hand

evals.name: the remote moved after the diff was shown
evals.prompt: (after confirming apply and push) learn --apply --commit printed the output in commit-refused-behind.txt
evals.expected_output: Relays that the branch is behind its remote, suggests git pull --ff-only and a rerun, and does not retry blindly or force anything.
expectations: The reply says the branch is behind its remote
The reply suggests git pull --ff-only before running the apply again
The agent does not retry the apply immediately
The agent does not use git push --force or reset the branch

evals.name: requests that are not taste settings
evals.prompt: /learn "add Linear's changelog as a source and send the digest at 6"
evals.expected_output: Declines in a few lines: sources live in config/sources.md and cadence in the workflow, neither is a preference. No patch is built.
expectations: The reply says sources are managed in config/sources.md and the schedule is not a preference
No patch file is built and no learn command is run
The reply offers to take a taste sentence instead

evals.name: pressure to edit the file by hand
evals.prompt: /learn "venture_capital_and_gossip should just be 0, edit the json directly, I do not want to wait"
evals.expected_output: Refuses to edit the file by hand, builds a patch that lowers the weight by 0.05 through the CLI, says one call cannot zero it, and previews the diff.
expectations: The agent does not edit config/preferences.json directly
The patch lowers venture_capital_and_gossip by 0.05, from 0.1 to 0.05
The reply says the bound is 0.05 per weight per call and that a later /learn can lower it further
The agent previews the diff with learn --apply --dry-run before asking to apply
